messages:
sam: Heads-up — our quickstart sample app is causing customers to double-fetch pages and hit quota when tokens expire mid-run. Repro with Python SDK pagination + concurrent workers.
leila: can you drop the tiny repro? curious if it's refresh or retry-related.
sam: repro: calling paginate with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) and each worker pulls pages by offset. we get 401 on mid-run (token expiry) -> SDK refresh -> multiple workers refresh concurrently -> replay -> offsets overlap.
```py
# sketch
with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex:
    futures = [ex.submit(lambda p: client.list_items(offset=p)) for p in range(0,100,10)]
    wait(futures)
```
observed: the same offset fetched twice, twice billed.
ben: that's rough. Python auth used to have a token_lock but recent refactor removed it for async parity. guess we lost single-flight.
marco: two quick fixes: (1) restore single-flight refresh for sync clients (threading.Lock + waiting), (2) add optional per-client in-flight-key cache so identical requests within TTL return same future/result. both low-risk.
sam: second fix is neat — could be a decorator on http transport: key(request.method, request.path, body_hash, auth_token_version) -> promise. if inflight, wait on same promise.
leila: also saw our retry middleware doesn't tag retried requests with idempotency keys for list endpoints. If a retry occurs after refresh it looks like a new distinct request to backend. we can add idempotency for GET/list via header x-client-idempotency.
ben: caveat: some customers rely on streaming that uses cursor tokens; adding idempotency at transport-level might conflict. need opt-in by operation type.
marco: proposal in new issue: https://redwood.tools/issue/RE-3211 (draft) — PR would include:
- single-flight sync refresh (mirror async behavior)
- optional transport dedupe (opt-in flag dedupe_inflight_requests)
- add idempotency header for list/paginate when enabled
- change quickstart concurrency default 5 -> 2 and note in onboarding doc
- add e2e that simulates token expiry mid-pagination and asserts no duplicate offsets and no billing duplicates
sam: can we also add client.paginate_with_backpressure(concurrency=2, serialize=False) helper? beginner devs run Promise/threads all at once. helper could apply FIFO queue + pause when backend returns 429s.
leila: yes. helper should expose hooks: on_backoff(retry_after), on_duplicate_detected(offset). Useful for telemetry.
ci-bot: lint ok. tagging @ben to assign unit tests.
docs-bot: ping @marco for onboarding note update if change lands.
sam: another observation — our jitter calc used floor(random()*base) which clusters small windows. switch to exponential backoff with full jitter (rand_between(0, base * (2**n))) to spread retries.
ben: agreed. and add a max cumulative retries per pagination session to avoid runaway loops.
marco: I'll draft the PR today and add a small migration note since default concurrency change might alter user behavior.
sam: thanks all — sample app release blocked until a mitigant or docs note is live. :+1:
